Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Hassell
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 250 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Port Authority by an undetermined amount to allow the Authority to purchase, construct, and operate inland property and facilities, including intermodal and multi-modal facilities. These obligations could be offset by increased fees assessed from the use of any new facilities.
Further, this bill would allow the Authority to issue bonds for the purchase, construction, or improvement of such inland facilities.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
